title: deaddrop.json placeholder frames don't parse as CoAP after string substitution
description: Edge codereview of b7z9.119.1 (out-of-scope observation): several placeholder-style frames in test/vectors/deaddrop.json (e.g. '4402000183deaddropc0') do not parse as CoAP after the test's string substitution — TKL=4 consumes the option delta byte, unlike the correct 0xb8 frames. Pre-existing vector-file issue; b7z9.119.4 (deaddrop SCHC vectors) should either fix or regenerate these.
